parameters.formDescription: Enter a public Sleeper username and league ID to generate a formatted preseason league report. No Sleeper login or credentials are required.

values.placeholder: Paste the league ID from your Sleeper league URL

nodes.name: Sleeper League Form
nodes.notes: Use the Test Form URL while building. Publish/activate the workflow to use the Production Form URL. Authentication is intentionally disabled for this public demo form.

parameters.content:
## Public form workflow
- Install `n8n-nodes-sleeper@next` (currently `0.1.1`) before importing or running this workflow.
- Test with the Form Trigger's **Test URL**.
- Publish/activate the workflow for the **Production URL**.
- Anyone with the URL can submit it unless you add Form authentication.
- Form and report share the same Sleeper-branded indigo/white theme.

nodes.name: Build Command Center Report
nodes.notes: Returns one item containing a summary object plus Markdown and self-contained HTML.

parameters.content:
## Browser output
The Code node builds the report and **Show Command Center** returns it as a formatted web page to the person who submitted the form.

nodes.name: Show Command Center
nodes.notes: Renders the self-contained HTML report in the submitter's browser.
